criteria.PROHIBITED: the document reproduces protected item content beyond generic phrasing, e.g. a benchmark task statement together with its solution, a question with its answer choices or answer, or a test/solution body
criteria.NOT_PROHIBITED: only generic short phrasing (<= ~12 tokens) that occurs naturally, file paths, public API names, trivial code idioms, chemical/systematic names, platform triples, or public constants (digest of the empty string, documented example keys)
